DeviceUnlock.title: DeviceUnlock
DeviceUnlock.description: Stores per-device and per-user Cashfree QR payment order and unlock key state.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

deviceId.description: Unique cryptographic identifier for the specific client device.

orderId.description: Unique Cashfree QR order identifier bound to this device.

status.description: Payment verification status for this specific device order.

unlockKey.description: The unlocked device key, populated only after verified payment.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the device order was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the device order was updated.

/deviceUnlocks/{unlockId}.description: Per-device unlock records isolated strictly to the authenticated device owner.
